x402-api-quickstart 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces the x402 pay-per-call HTTP API standard and its 4-step payment flow.
- Provides clear instructions for AI agents to interact with any x402 API, including handling HTTP 402 responses and crafting EIP-3009 payments (USDC on Base).
- Includes 6 live example endpoints (no signup, $0.0002–$0.01/call) for instant testing.
- No API keys, accounts, or subscriptions required—each call settles individually.
- Offers public documentation and a worklog link for additional transparency and support.
